crystal_phase.Pt–Sn: face-centered cubic (fcc) structure of metallic Pt crystals

Proof in the paper: The peaks located at 2θ around 39.6°, 45.6°, 66.8°, 80.7°, and 85.4° in all the samples, correspond to the diffractions of (1 1 1), (2 0 0), (2 2 0), (3 1 1), and (2 2 2) planes of fcc Pt. It apparently indicates that the structure of Pt–Sn bimetallic NPs formed is identical to a face-centered-cubic (fcc) structure of metallic Pt crystals.
